name: Achilles Insertional Tendinopathy
definition: Degenerative load-related pain at the Achilles tendon insertion on the calcaneus, often associated with compression and enthesophyte formation.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; ultrasound/MRI is used for persistent symptoms or suspected tear.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Progressive calf loading modified to reduce insertional compression
amber: Injection into tendon should be avoided; surgery is selective for refractory disease.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative load-related pain at the Achilles tendon insertion on the calcaneus, often associated with compression and enthesophyte formation.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
